title: Water Damage Mitigation Dispatch Cancellation Clause
content:
**Customer terms — cancelling a Water Damage Mitigation dispatch**

The job must be in dispatched status when the dispatch is cancelled. A customer who declines the work after the crew has been dispatched, and before signing the work authorization, may cancel the dispatch; the service call already charged stays billable, nothing else is charged, and the cancelled job's service call balance is due within the self-pay payment terms counted from the cancelled date. Once the authorization is signed the job can no longer be cancelled; a customer who wants to stop drying after equipment is set does so through the Early Equipment Removal Release.

## Condition, judgement, result
| Job status when the customer declines | May the dispatch be cancelled? | What remains billable |
|---|---|---|
| Dispatched (authorization not signed) | yes | the service call already charged, and nothing else |
| Authorized or later | no | — (stopping drying after equipment is set goes through the Early Equipment Removal Release) |

## Due date of the remaining balance
The service call balance of a cancelled job falls due at the end of the tier's self-pay payment terms, the calendar days being counted from the cancelled date rather than from any invoice date.
